verses.translation: Moreover the Spirit took me up, and brought me to the front gate of the house of the Lord, that looks eastward: and behold at the entrance of the gate were about five and twenty men; and I saw in the midst of them Jechonias the son of Ezer, and Phaltias the son of Banæas, the leaders of the people.

translations.ron: Atunci m-a ridicat Duhul şi m-a dus la poarta de răsărit a templului Domnului, care este spre răsărit. Şi iată în poartă, la intrare, erau douăzeci şi cinci de oameni şi în mijlocul lor am văzut pe Iaazania, fiul lui Azur, şi pe Pelatia, fiul lui Benaia, căpeteniile poporului.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἀνέλαβέ με πνεῦμα, καὶ ἤγαγέ με ἐπὶ τὴν πύλην τοῦ οἴκου Κυρίου τὴν κατέναντι, τὴν βλέπουσαν κατὰ ἀνατολάς· καὶ ἰδοὺ ἐπὶ τῶν προθύρων τῆς πύλης ὡς εἴκοσι καὶ πέντε ἄνδρες, καὶ ἴδον ἐν μέσῳ αὐτῶν τὸν Ἰεχονίαν τὸν τοῦ Ἔζερ, καὶ Φαλτίαν τὸν τοῦ Βαναίου, τοὺς ἀφηγουμένους τοῦ λαοῦ.

verses.translation: And the Lord said to me, Son of man, these are the men that devise vanities, and take evil counsel in this city:

translations.ron: Şi mi-a zis Domnul: "Fiul omului, iată oamenii care gândesc nelegiuirea şi care dau sfaturi rele în cetatea aceasta,
translations.grk: Καὶ εἶπε Κύριος πρὸς μὲ, υἱὲ ἀνθρώπου, οὗτοι οἱ ἄνδρες οἱ λογιζόμενοι μάταια καὶ βουλευόμενοι βουλὴν πονηρὰν ἐν τῇ πόλει ταύτῃ·

verses.translation: who say, Have not the houses been newly built? This is the caldron, and we are the flesh.

translations.ron: Zicând: "Încă n-a venit vremea să ne zidim case; cetatea este cazanul, iar noi carnea".
translations.grk: Οἱ λέγοντες, οὐχὶ προσφάτως ᾠκοδόμηνται αἱ οἰκίαι; αὕτη ἐστὶν ὁ λέβης, ἡμεῖς δὲ τὰ κρέα.

verses.translation: Therefore prophesy against them, prophesy, son of man.

translations.ron: De aceea prooroceşte, fiul omului, prooroceşte împotriva lor!"
translations.grk: Διατοῦτο προφήτευσον ἐπʼ αὐτοὺς, προφήτευσον υἱὲ ἀνθρώπου.

verses.translation: And the Spirit of the Lord fell upon me, and said to me, say; Thus saith the Lord; Thus have ye said, O house of Israel: and I know the devices of your spirit.

translations.ron: Atunci S-a pogorât peste mine Duhul Domnului şi mi-a zis: "Spune: Aşa grăieşte Domnul: Casa lui Israel, cele ce ziceţi voi şi cele ce vă vin în minte le ştiu.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἔπεσεν ἐπʼ ἐμὲ πνεῦμα Κυρίου, καὶ εἶπε πρὸς μὲ, λέγε, Τάδε λέγει Κύριος, οὕτως εἴπατε οἶκος Ἰσραήλ, καὶ τὰ διαβούλια τοῦ πνεύματος ὑμῶν ἐγὼ ἐπίσταμαι.

verses.translation: Ye have multiplied your dead in this city, and ye have filled your ways with slain men.

translations.ron: Mulţi aţi ucis voi în cetatea aceasta şi aţi umplut uliţele ei de trupuri.
translations.grk: Ἐπληθύνατε νεκροὺς ὑμῶν ἐν τῇ πόλει ταύτῃ, καὶ ἐνεπλήσατε τὰς ὁδοὺς αὐτῶν τραυματιῶν.

verses.translation: Therefore thus saith the Lord; Your dead whom ye have smitten in the midst of it, these are the flesh, and thiscity is the caldron: but I will bring you forth out of the midst of it.

translations.ron: De aceea aşa zice Domnul Dumnezeu: Ucişii pe care i-aţi îngropat în ea sunt carnea, iar ea e căldarea. Pe voi însă vă voi scoate din ea.
translations.grk: Διατοῦτο τάδε λέγει Κύριος, τοὺς νεκροὺς ὑμῶν οὓς ἐπατάξατε ἐν μέσῳ αὐτῆς, οὗτοί εἰσι τὰ κρέα, αὕτὴ δὲ ὁ λέβης ἐστὶ, καὶ ὑμᾶς ἐξάξω ἐκ μέσου αὐτῆς.

verses.translation: Ye fear the sword; and I will bring a sword upon you, saith the Lord.

translations.ron: Voi vă temeţi de sabie, şi sabie voi aduce asupra voastră, zice Domnul Dumnezeu.
translations.grk: Ῥομφαίαν φοβεῖσθε, καὶ ῥομφαίαν ἐπάξω ἐφʼ ὑμᾶς, λέγει Κύριος.

verses.translation: And I will bring you forth out of the midst of it, and will deliver you into the hands of strangers, and will execute judgments among you.

translations.ron: Vă voi scoate din ea, vă voi da pe mâna străinilor şi vă voi judeca.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἐξάξω ὑμᾶς ἐκ μέσου αὐτῆς, καὶ παραδώσω ὑμᾶς εἰς χεῖρας ἀλλοτρίων, καὶ ποιήσω ἐν ὑμῖν κρίματα,

verses.translation: Ye shall fall by the sword; I will judge you on the mountains of Israel; and ye shall know that I am the Lord.

translations.ron: De sabie veţi cădea; la hotarele lui Israel vă voi judeca, şi veţi cunoaşte că Eu sunt Domnul.
translations.grk: ἐν ῥομφαίᾳ πεσεῖσθε, ἐπὶ τῶν ὀρέων τοῦ Ἰσραὴλ κρινῶ ὑμᾶς, καὶ ἐπιγνώσεσθε ὅτι ἐγὼ Κύριος.

verses.translation: And it came to pass, while I was prophesying, that Phaltias the son of Banæas died. And I fell upon my face, and cried with a loud voice, and said, Alas, alas, O Lord! wilt thou utterly destroy the remnant of Israel?

translations.ron: Pe când prooroceam eu, Pelatia, fiul lui Benaia, a murit. Atunci eu am căzut cu faţa la pământ şi am strigat cu glas mare, zicând: "O, Doamne Dumnezeule, oare voieşti să pierzi ce a mai rămas lui Israel?"
translations.grk: καὶ ἐγένετο ἐν τῷ προφητεύειν με, καὶ Φαλτίας ὁ τοῦ Βαναίου ἀπέθανε· καὶ πίπτω ἐπὶ πρόσωπόν μου, καὶ ἀνεβόησα φωνῇ μεγάλῃ, καὶ εἶπα, οἴμοι οἴμοι Κύριε, εἰς συντέλειαν ποιεῖς σὺ τοὺς καταλοίπους τοῦ Ἰσραήλ;

verses.translation: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying,

translations.ron: Atunci a fost către mine cuvântul Domnului şi mi-a zis:
translations.grk: Καὶ ἐγένετο λόγος Κυρίου πρὸς μὲ, λέγων,

verses.translation: Son of man, thy brethren, and the men of thy captivity, and all the house of Israel are come to the full, to whom the inhabitants of Jerusalem said, Keep ye far away from the Lord: the land is given to us for an inheritance.

translations.ron: "Fiul omului, aceştia sunt fraţii tăi, fraţii tăi de un sânge cu tine, şi toată casa lui Israel, cărora locuitorii Ierusalimului le zic: "Depărtaţi-vă de Domnul! Ţara asta nouă ni s-a dat de moştenire".
translations.grk: υἱὲ ἀνθρώπου, οἱ ἀδελφοί σου καὶ οἱ ἄνδρες τῆς αἰχμαλωσίας σου καὶ πᾶς ὁ οἶκος τοῦ Ἰσραὴλ συντετέλεσται, οἷς εἶπαν αὐτοῖς οἱ κατοικοῦντες Ἱερουσαλὴμ, μακρὰν ἀπέχετε ἀπὸ τοῦ Κυρίου, ἡμῖν δέδοται ἡ γῆ εἰς κληρονομίαν.

verses.translation: Therefore say thou, Thus saith the Lord; I will cast them off among the nations, and will disperse them into every land, yet will I be to them for a little sanctuary in the countries which they shall enter.

translations.ron: La aceasta să zici: Aşa zice Domnul Dumnezeu: Deşi i-am depărtat printre popoare şi deşi i-am risipit prin ţări, totuşi voi fi pentru ei un locaş sfânt în acele ţări unde îi voi risipi.
translations.grk: Διατοῦτο εἰπὸν, Τάδε λέγει Κύριος, ὅτι ἀπώσομαι αὐτοὺς εἰς τὰ ἔθνη, καὶ διασκορπιῶ αὐτοὺς εἰς πᾶσαν γῆν, καὶ ἔσομαι αὐτοῖς εἰς ἁγίασμα μικρὸν ἐν ταῖς χώραις, οὗ ἐὰν εἰσέλθωσιν ἐκεῖ.

verses.translation: Therefore say thou, Thus saith the Lord; I will also take them from the heathen, and gather them out of the lands wherein I have scattered them, and will give them the land of Israel.

translations.ron: După aceea zi: Aşa grăieşte Domnul Dumnezeu: Vă voi aduna de prin popoare şi vă voi întoarce de prin ţările unde sunteţi risipiţi şi vă voi da pământul lui Israel.
translations.grk: Διατοῦτο εἰπὸν, τάδε λέγει Κύριος, καὶ εἰσδέξομαι αὐτοὺς ἐκ τῶν ἐθνῶν, καὶ συνάξω αὐτοὺς ἐκ τῶν χωρῶν οὗ διέσπειρα αὐτοὺς ἐν αὐταῖς· καὶ δώσω αὐτοῖς τὴν γῆν τοῦ Ἰσραήλ.

verses.translation: And they shall enter in there, and shall remove all the abominations of it, and all its iniquities from it.

translations.ron: Atunci vor veni acolo şi vor depărta din el toate urâciunile şi toţi idolii.
translations.grk: Καὶ εἰσελεύσονται ἐκεῖ, καὶ ἐξαροῦσι πάντα τὰ βδελύγματα αὐτῆς καὶ πάσας τὰς ἀνομίας αὐτῆς ἐξ αὐτῆς.

verses.translation: And I will give them another heart, and will put a new spirit within them; and will extract the heart of stone from their flesh, and give them a heart of flesh:

translations.ron: Şi le voi da aceeaşi inimă şi duh nou voi pune în ei; voi scoate din trupul lor inima cea de piatră şi le voi da inimă de carne,
translations.grk: Καὶ δώσω αὐτοῖς καρδίαν ἑτέραν, καὶ πνεῦμα καινὸν δώσω ἐν αὐτοῖς, καὶ ἐκσπάσω τὴν καρδίαν τὴν λιθίνην ἐκ τῆς σαρκὸς αὐτῶν, καὶ δώσω αὐτοῖς καρδίαν σαρκίνην·

verses.translation: that they may walk in my commandments, and keep mine ordinances, and do them: and they shall be to me a people, and I will be to them a God.

translations.ron: Ca să urmeze poruncile Mele şi legile să le păzească şi să le împlinească; vor fi poporul Meu, iar Eu le voi fi Dumnezeu.
translations.grk: Ὅπως ἐν τοῖς προστάγμασί μου πορεύωνται, καὶ τὰ δικαιώματά μου φυλάσσωνται καὶ ποιῶσιν αὐτὰ, καὶ ἔσονταί μοι εἰς λαὸν, καὶ ἐγὼ ἔσομαι αὐτοῖς εἰς Θεόν.

verses.translation: And as for the heart set upon their abominations and their iniquities, as their heart went after them, I have recompensed their ways on their heads, saith the Lord.

translations.ron: Celor a căror inimă este legată de idolii lor şi de urâciunile lor le voi cere socoteală de purtarea lor", zice Domnul Dumnezeu.
translations.grk: Καὶ εἰς τὴν καρδίαν τῶν βδελυγμάτων αὐτῶν καὶ τῶν ἀνομιῶν αὐτῶν, ὡς ἡ καρδία αὐτῶν ἐπορεύετο, τὰς ὁδοὺς αὐτῶν εἰς τὰς κεφαλὰς αὐτῶν δέδωκα, λέγει Κύριος.

verses.translation: Then the cherubs lifted up their wings, and the wheels beside them; and the glory of the God of Israel was over them above.

translations.ron: Atunci heruvimii şi-au întins aripile şi roţile erau lângă ei, iar slava Dumnezeului lui Israel, sus, deasupra lor.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἐξῇραν τὰ χερουβὶμ τὰς πτέρυγας αὐτῶν, καὶ οἱ τροχοὶ ἐχόμενοι αὐτῶν, καὶ ἡ δόξα Θεοῦ Ἰσραὴλ ἐπʼ αὐτὰ ὑπεράνω αὐτῶν.

verses.translation: And the glory of the Lord went up from the midst of the city, and stood on the mountain which was in front of the city.

translations.ron: Apoi slava Domnului s-a ridicat din mijlocul cetăţii şi a stat deasupra muntelui, care se află spre răsărit de cetate.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἀνέβη ἡ δόξα Κυρίου ἐκ μέσης τῆς πόλεως, καὶ ἔστη ἐπὶ τοῦ ὄρους ὃ ἦν ἀπέναντι τῆς πόλεως.

verses.translation: And the Spirit took me up, and brought me to the land of the Chaldeans, to the captivity, in a vision by the Spirit of God: and I went up after the vision which I saw.

translations.ron: Atunci iar m-a luat Duhul şi m-a dus în Caldeea, la cei robiţi, cuprins de vedeniile ce le aveam prin Duhul lui Dumnezeu. Şi vedenia pe care o văzusem s-a depărtat de la mine.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἀνέλαβέ με πνεῦμα, καὶ ἤγαγέ με εἰς γῆν Χαλδαίων εἰς τὴν αἰχμαλωσίαν ἐν ὁράσει ἐν πνεύματι Θεοῦ· καὶ ἀνέβην ἀπὸ τῆς ὁράσεως ἧς ἴδον.

verses.translation: And I spoke to the captivity all the words of the Lord which he had shewed me.

translations.ron: Şi am spus celor ce au fost duşi în robie toate cuvintele Domnului pe care mi le descoperise El.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἐλάλησα πρὸς τὴν αἰχμαλωσίαν πάντας τοὺς λόγους τοῦ Κυρίου οὓς ἔδειξέ μοι.
